### Summary

I found no issues. Both changes move `@kaipu/domain` from `devDependencies` to `dependencies` in `packages/application` and `packages/infra-db`. Each package imports runtime values from it, so this is correct. It doesn't break the import rules: `application` and `infra-db` may depend on `domain`, and no `infra-*` import is added to `application`. No install scripts are introduced.
